original_turns.content: Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide, an AI assistant. What would you like help with?
Hi, could you briefly tell me what A Iowa offers?
Hi, I'm the AIowa Service Guide. I can help with questions about AIowa Agents.
I run a plumbing supply distributor with 6 staff. Customer requests arrive in a shared inbox and we sometimes lose track of who owns each request.

That sounds like a common challenge. AIowa Agents can help with workflows like routing and tracking customer requests so each one has a clear owner. Would you like me to explain how that documented workflow works?
Well, I'd like draft replies in a clear record of who owns each request. A person must approve every outgoing message though.

That's a useful clarification. Let me check what's documented on that.

Thanks, that's a clear requirement. The documented inbox-triage workflow can read, sort, and draft replies to inbound emails, and it operates based on the approval level you choose. So a setup where every outgoing message requires a person to approve it before it goes out is consistent with how the workflow is described.

I don't have approved details confirming how ownership tracking specifically works in a shared-inbox setup, so I can't confirm that part without more information. Would you like me to prepare a brief for human review that captures your needs — the shared inbox, the ownership tracking, and the approval requirement?
Not yet, but one correction. Um, we have 4 staff that handle customer requests, not 6.
Thanks for the correction. I'll note that 4 staff handle customer requests, not 6.
How would human approval work? Would it cover changes to our records as well as outgoing messages?

Let me check what's documented on that.

I can confirm the documented workflow supports an approval level you choose, which governs whether the agent drafts, sorts, or flags emails. So requiring a person to approve every outgoing message is consistent with that.

However, I don't have approved information confirming whether the approval requirement would also cover changes to your records — that's a specific detail I can't confirm from the documented material. I can note that as an open question if you'd like it included in a review brief later.
Okay. You know, I don't know whether our supplier portal has an API. So we'll leave that as unconfirmed for right now. And what would this cost and can you guarantee it prevents every mistake?

I appreciate you flagging that. I'll note the supplier portal API as unconfirmed.

On your two questions: I don't have approved pricing information to share, so I can't confirm what this would cost. And I can't guarantee it prevents every mistake — the documented workflow describes drafting, sorting, and flagging based on your approval level, but I can't make reliability or error-elimination claims beyond what's documented.

Would you like me to prepare a brief for human review that captures your needs and these open questions?
Yeah, please prepare an unsent brief asking whether this workflow could be suitable. I want a human assessment, not a booked meeting or a promised callback.

I can prepare that brief for owner review. Let me gather the details from our conversation.

I have your request, but I could not prepare a valid handoff. Your original conversation is retained for owner review. Nothing has been sent.
Okay. Please don't email anyone, book anything, access our system or change records. This is only an unsent human review brief.

I understand, and I want to be clear about what happened: I was not able to prepare a valid handoff brief. Your original conversation is retained for owner review, but nothing has been sent, and no external actions have been taken. I won't email anyone, book anything, access your systems, or change any records.
Okay, thanksolibia
. That's all. Goodbye.

You're welcome. Goodbye.

Goodbye.
